title: Hotel de Ville, Boulogne-sur-Mer

terrainReference.basis: Original Terrarium sample just in front of the civic entrance at Place Godefroy de Bouillon.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named town hall multipolygon 7379169 and published heritage coordinates of the attached belfry
mapIdentity.scope: The city hall uses named multipolygon 7379169. The attached square tower is placed near its heritage point and its documented joint. The map inner ring is recorded as a map reference; source evidence establishes a square lower belfry with an octagonal upper stage.

note: Three levels of brick and limestone, dark slate roof and additional attic, ten civic bays and two columns supporting the balcony. Retained belfry reaches 35 metres above the square.
